explanation: Cheesemakers once matured it in the caves of Cheddar Gorge. The name travelled with the recipe, and cheddar is made around the world, from Australia to Canada.

claims.text: Cheddar cheese is named after the village of Cheddar in Somerset, England.

Cheddar was traditionally matured in the caves of Cheddar Gorge.
Cheddar is made in many countries, including Australia and Canada.
